title: Keep one stalled writable open from making every other open of an established store refuse busy
outcome: Keep one stalled writable open from making every other open of an established store refuse busy
acceptance: A writable open of a store that is already in write-ahead-log mode with its schema no longer holds the cross-process open lock through its whole preflight and any locking-protocol retry, or a stalled holder no longer makes other writable openers refuse busy after the five-second wait; whichever design is chosen keeps concurrent first opens of a new store serialized
A test shows another writable opener of an established store is admitted while one opener is stalled in its preflight
